exposure: gestational age at elective repeat caesarean
cohort: 503 women undergoing elective repeat caesarean section
finding: Elective early-term caesarean delivery appears to negatively impact immediate neonatal outcome.
mod_finding: Neonates born by elective repeat caesarean in early term had a 3.2 times increased risk of being admitted to the NICU due to foetal adaption disorders in the early post-natal phase.
